title: The Beatles watch Billy Fury live | 1962
content:
Prior to their evening show at the Cavern Club, on 21 October 1962 The Beatles watched Billy Fury perform an afternoon concert in Liverpool.

It took place at the Empire Theatre, where The Beatles would perform one week later, and on several subsequent occasions.

Fury was Liverpool’s most successful pop artist at this time, and chalked up 26 hit singles between 1961 and 1966. The Beatles had unsuccessfully auditioned to become his backing band on 10 May 1960, and were chosen instead to tour Scotland with Johnny Gentle.
